jsonLd.name: Facial Harmonization in Miami
jsonLd.description: Facial harmonization at Real Aesthetic Medical Spa in Miami is a signature, multi-area injectable plan that combines hyaluronic acid fillers, neuromodulator, and — when indicated — a biostimulator, designed by Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C, to bring proportion, balance, and refinement to the face as a whole.

mainEntity.name: Is facial harmonization a single procedure or a plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a personalised plan, not a single procedure. After consultation, Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C designs a sequence of small interventions across two or three sessions that combine HA fillers, neuromodulator, and sometimes a biostimulator. The plan is written before any product is injected, and the patient receives a copy describing areas, sequencing, and timeline.

mainEntity.name: Will my face look different or just more rested?

acceptedAnswer.text: The goal is a more rested, balanced, in-proportion version of you — not a different face. We use your own bone structure as the map and aim for a result that family and colleagues read as "you look great" rather than "what did you do?" Conservative dosing, photographic planning, and the two-week review protect that outcome.

No. It is a powerful non-surgical plan, but it does not replace surgery in cases of significant skin laxity, advanced ptosis, or pronounced skeletal asymmetries. We are clear during consultation about what injectables can and cannot do. When a surgical referral is the right answer, we say so.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Treats the face as a whole, restoring the relationship between the upper, middle, and lower thirds rather than over-correcting one area.
Combines structural projection, dynamic relaxation, and tissue quality in one coordinated plan.
Uses the patient's own bone structure and proportions as the map — no generic templates.
Reduces the cumulative cost and downtime of treating zones in isolation over several years.
Refines profile, frontal symmetry, and light reflection across cheeks and jawline simultaneously.
Built on reversible HA when adjustability is a priority; biostimulator added only when indicated.
Designed and supervised by Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C, with photographic planning and review at every stage.
